Hello しゃぁねぇsensei,

Thank you for considering this commission.

I'd like to request for an illustration of my vtuber character in any style you like.
He is a bartender and part of the Chinese mafia, living in a fictional Chinatown.
For this request, please feel free to draw him in any pose and situation you like. 
Please feel free to draw him in either the mafia outfit of the bartender outfit.

I only have three requests:
1. Please keep his expression neutral, as he is emotionless no matter what is happening.
2. Please be aware of the scar on his left eye brow and a mole near his right eye. 
3. If you draw a background, please keep the character and background on separate layers of the PSD.

I have included the reference in the URL.
Thank you again, I look forward to seeing your work!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1D92akpTPkVK-w3PaO_o0ARPz0D5E6qox?usp=drive_link

Nice to meet you. 
I was drawn to Shaa-nee-sama’s dark yet cute art style, meticulous coloring, and wonderful use of props in your illustrations, so I’m sending this request to have you draw an illustration of one of my favorite creators…!  

[Character Reference]
I’d like to request an illustration of VTuber KiLA.
Character: A genius musician who loves rock music
Gender: Male
Representative Color: Red (Red x Black)
He sings rock songs, plays electric guitar, and focuses his activities primarily on music. 
I have stored reference materials at the URL below.
The character in the standing illustration marked ① is the second one from the left.
Reference URL: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dYwHpOQgguiw-ILkpg3UjxWXlToF7eZA 
*We have obtained the artist’s permission during a livestream regarding requests via Skeb and similar platforms. Additionally, his agency’s guidelines permit fan art. https://jp.maha5.com/guideline  

[Composition] 
I’ll leave the composition and pose up to you.
I would appreciate it if the character’s head, shoulders, and upper body were not cropped out of the frame as much as possible.
I’d like an illustration with a rock vibe, featuring motifs such as red roses, electric guitars, chains, and silver accessories.  

【Delivery Format】 
I would appreciate it if you could also provide PNG or PSD files with the character and background separated.  

【Intended Use】 
This is for personal viewing. 
Please note that the illustration you create may be shared with the artist themselves. In such cases, we may post it on social media with your name/ID and a @ mention.
Additionally, if we share the illustration, we would appreciate your permission for the artist to use it. The intended uses include thumbnails for a YouTube channel, use during live streams or in videos, social media posts, and use as icons or headers. (Text overlays or color adjustments may be applied.)
Since the artwork may be used for the purposes listed above, please feel free to cancel the order if you find this difficult or inconvenient.  

That concludes my request. 
If the payment amount is insufficient or there are any errors, I would appreciate it if you could resend the payment. 

I apologize for the lengthy message. I know you are very busy, but I would greatly appreciate your consideration! 🙇‍♀️

I love your art! I love the dark atmosphere and the way you paint and use the backgroun and items in your compositions! I'd be so happy if you could draw my Vtuber original character!

【Composition】
Feel free to draw her however you'd like! I'd love to have a background, and if she could either be sitting or laying down. I love those works specifically: https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/45 + https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/43 + https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/37 + https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/35
I love if you could draw her in her main outfit, with or without the cape. But if you prefer you can choose another outfit (casual or maid).

【Character personality and story】
- She is a retired magical girl. Years ago she defeated the evil lord and lost all her friends (the other magical girls that fought by her side). Now she's all alone and without a purpose. Her destructive powers are of no use in a world that's trying to heal and be rebuilt.
- She's a lonely kuudere with a tragic past.
- She has two scars on her face, and her eyelashes are the same color as her hair.
- She stopped aging around her late 20s, so she has a more mature look and vibe.
- The heart jewel on her chest is chipped/broken in a few places, it's supposed to glow all the time but nowadays it only glows when she's smiling or laughing.
- Her powers are time-based: she can absorb other live being's lifespans and convert it in a destructive fire to defeat her enemies.
- A motif I use a lot in my graphics is the spent hourglass (hourglass done).
- The setting is post-apocalyptic.
- She decided to start streaming (she's a Virtual Youtuber now) so she can extend her lifespan through other people willingly watching her and giving her a bit of their time... She also really enjoys other people's company and the new sense of purpose that streaming gives her.
- She feel very much at home in her streams, so she's able to get out of her shell. When she does, she can become smug and sassy and even a little bit mean, but all in good faith. She also like to joke around and play pranks on other people.
- She is quite clumsy and bad at games.

【Usage】
- To post on SNS, thumbnails, Twitch, Youtube
- I would like the character, background and signature layers separated, if that is okay!

【My references and character sheet】
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dL4wncGk_bTDCfI_K7pVKVterbJmAo5s?usp=sharing

If the price is unfit, please feel free to resend.
Thank you for your consideration!
